this game lure you into a false sense of security. It first start you with bot so you think you are hot shit, then slowly matches you with more player, and then no more matchmaking, so you get some tryhard who know all the line since the stuff isn't random, just like in the beginning of fall guy.

then there's the play/pay to get ability. In fall guy, everyone can grab, in this game you have to reach a certain level in the battle pass to unlock the emote that allow you to grab, and level up more for the emote to punch.

--its a pay to win format on a already paid game--

if you can't afford fall guys or it's hard for you, then stumble guys is the best choice, the best thing about this game is you can play with your friends that are using mobile + its working on a Low-End PC.
